title: 第26章 西关人家第27章 老太太的态度
content_zh:
龙家位于东省的省会花城，三人驾车约莫两小时后便来到了龙家在西关的大屋。
车子在一处拐角停下，白月便看到眼前西关大屋的景象。只看外围，这房屋的占地面积已是非常惊人，至少有两千多个平方。
屋外两旁是石板铺的小巷，需要人步行走进，在外便看到这由角门、木趟栊和红木组成三重门扇，还以花岗石为嵌的大门，还有屋外那隐约可见的蚀刻满洲窗，白月只觉得一股浓浓的岭南气息迎面扑来。
龙子真上前按了一下门铃，边等待着里面的人来开门，边跟一旁的白月解释道：“这是我们龙家的老宅子，平常这里只有老太太和家里的管家仆人们住，我父亲一代都已经搬到新城区的别墅内，而三代则只有我一个人，从小都在国外生活。”
“一周后是老太太的生辰，我们这些小辈都要提前赶回来看望她，今日我家族的人应该都在这老宅子里，你进去后最好不要说话，让傅少给你撑场面，我大伯断不会多说什么。”
白月听到龙子真的这话，心中开始有了计较，原来这龙子真的家中除了老太太，就数他这大伯的地位最高，而且听他的描述，似乎是个挺有威严的人。
然而就是这般有威严的家族话事人，竟然会这么卖面子给傅心莲这么个二十出头的小伙子？就算他是京城博物馆馆长的关门弟子，就算他是京城第一豪门的未来继承人，也不至于到这般听信的地步吧？
只能说这傅心莲的人格魅力着实强大，不过转而想到傅心莲那实在让人觉得放心靠谱的办事效率，白月也就释然了。
前来开门的是一个头发花白，带着圆框眼镜，一身黑色长袍马褂的老人，他透过门前的木趟栊看到屋外的是自家三代的小少爷和傅大少，便急忙推过趟栊，恭恭敬敬的把少爷等人迎进门来。
“子真少爷，傅少爷，大小姐和大少他们正在正堂喝着茶，我们这就进去罢，还有这位小姐是？”老人看着夹在二人中间的白月问道。
“这位是傅少的朋友白月，这次主要也是来探望下老太太，给老太太来祝生辰的。”
龙子真忙含糊的回应道，生怕老人起疑，没进门便要把他们赶出去。
“原来是白小姐，这边请。”
老人自是把与傅少等人同行的白月当成是哪家的大小姐，毕竟能跟傅少搭上关系的朋友，那绝不会是普通人。
在行进至正堂时，龙子真便走到白月身边，俯身提醒道：“我说白月妹妹，您进去之后可不要像傅少第一次来大宅时那样，搞出一个大乌龙。”
说着便把眼神转向傅心莲身上瞥了瞥。
“哦？什么大乌龙？”
白月听着也来了兴致，能让这位温文尔雅的傅大少出糗，那肯定非常有趣。
“方才陈总管所说的大小姐，并不是我们家二代三代哪位年轻漂亮的小姐，我们家的大小姐就只有那么一个，就是我们家的老太太。陈总管之所以叫她大小姐，是因为陈总管是我们家的老管家了，他原本侍奉的老爷是我的爷爷，而老太太则是我爷爷的妹妹，而且并未嫁过人，所以便还是叫大小姐。”
“按理来说她应该算是我的姑婆，只不过平常我们背后都唤她老太太，傅少上次来大宅时以为我们家还有一位大小姐，结果闹出了笑话。”

“陈总管说的大少则是我的大伯，我龙家二代只有两个儿子，一个是我的大伯，一个是我的父亲，我爷爷和奶奶早些年已经去世了，所以一些大事上还是要过问老太太的。所以在这家中，对着其他人倒还没什么，对着我大伯和老太太，说话还是得小心些的。”
“对了，我家老太太是地道的广府人，并不会说普通话，只能听懂粤语和英语，到时候我会给你翻译的。”
“原来如此。”白月闻言后心中也多了个心眼。
待进到正堂后，白月便看到屋内大多都是由青砖堆砌，还有众多彩色的满洲窗装饰，正堂四面都是名贵的山水字画，座椅也全都是紫檀木制成的，其上都雕刻着花鸟鱼虫各式的浮雕。
只见大堂的中央正坐着一个雍容华贵的女子，一身暗红色的滚边旗袍，红唇卷发，妆容精致，坐在椅子上姿势得体优雅，一看就是富贵人家培养的大小姐，然而她眼神中的空洞却昭示着她现已失明的现实。
这就是龙家的老太太吗？这模样，看似也不过四十年华，现实却叫人想不到的是，她过了一周后的生辰便已经是花甲之年，好一个华贵优雅，保养得当的西关大小姐！
大堂两旁分别坐着两个中年人，左边的男子白月有过一面之缘，正是那日在拍卖会上第一个以一千万价格拍下龙泉窑青釉鬲式炉拍品的男人!
白月后来有了解过这个人，东省有名的房地产公司都是他的产业，老板龙景明！原来他就是龙子真的大伯！而在他面前正对坐着的，则是龙子真的父亲，龙景平！
此时陈总管已经上前给看不见的老太太通报着：“大小姐，子真少爷回来了。”
“是吗？子真回来啦？来，过来让我看看。”
座上的女子露出了些许高兴的神色，双手不断的往前摸索着，而她所说的看，自然也是摸。
龙子真走上前来，握住老太太摸索着的双手，放到自己脸上，温柔的说道：“姑婆，我是子真，我从国外回来看您了。”
“好，好，好。出门在外，还是得好好照顾自己，国外不比国内，想当初我在国外留学的那个时候，也受过不少的苦。”老太太抚摸着子真的脸，轻轻的叮嘱道。
“好，姑婆，我知道了。”龙子真乖巧的回答道，随后便蹲在老太太跟前，讨巧的说：“姑婆，您这不是眼睛不好嘛，我带了医生回来给您看看眼睛。”
听到龙子真的话，老太太瞬间拉下了脸，闷闷的道：“我不要吃那些胶囊药片，也不要做手术，那些化合物副作用太多了，对身体的伤害非常大，如果你带回来的是西医，那就让他们走吧。”
龙景明听到龙子真的话，急切的问道：“子真，你说带来的医生呢？在哪？”
龙子真怯怯的指傅心莲身旁的白月道：“就是这位白神医。”
龙景明等人顺着龙子真的方向望去，第一眼看到的便是傅心莲，忙微笑着朝他点头示意，随后便看到跟在傅心莲身旁的女孩。
“是她？她能治什么病？简直胡闹！”
龙景明等人看着年纪小小的白月，只觉得龙子真真的是荒谬至极！竟找来一个小女孩说是什么神医，莫不是被什么江湖骗子给忽悠了？

一旁的龙景平也把龙子真拉到了一边，一脸恨铁不成钢的模样瞪着他道：“就算你要找医生，也得找个像样点的来呀！”
被父亲大伯教训的龙子真一脸委屈的望向傅心莲求救，可是傅心莲此时却像是没看到一般，他想看看，在他不帮忙的情况下，此时的白月会有什么反应。
content_en:
The Long family is located in Huacheng, the capital of Eastern Province. The three of them drove to the Long family's big house in Xiguan about two hours later.
The car stopped at a corner, and Bai Yue saw the scene of Xiguan House in front of her. Just looking at the outside, the area of ​​​​this house is already amazing, at least more than 2,000 square meters.
There are alleys paved with stone on both sides of the house, and people need to walk in. Outside, they see the triple door leaf composed of a corner door, a wooden lattice and mahogany, a door inlaid with granite, and the vaguely etched Manchuria window outside the house. Bai Yue only feels a strong Lingnan atmosphere coming towards her.
Long Zizhen stepped forward and rang the doorbell, and while waiting for the people inside to open the door, he explained to Bai Yue beside him: "This is the old house of our Long family. Usually only the old lady and the housekeepers and servants live here. My father's generation has moved to the villa in the new city, and I am the only one in the third generation who has lived abroad since childhood."
"It's the old lady's birthday in a week. We juniors have to come back early to visit her. Everyone in my family should be in this old house today. It's best not to talk after you go in and let Mr. Fu support the scene for you. My uncle won't say anything more."
When Bai Yue heard Long Zizhen's words, she began to have doubts in her heart. It turned out that besides the old lady, Long Zizhen's uncle had the highest status in his family, and from his description, he seemed to be a very dignified person.
However, such a majestic family talker would actually sell face to a young man in his early twenties like Fu Xinlian? Even if he is the closed disciple of the director of the Beijing Museum, even if he is the future heir to the largest wealthy family in the capital, he will not be so obedient, right?
It can only be said that Fu Xinlian's personality charm is really powerful, but when she thinks of Fu Xinlian's reassuring and reliable work efficiency, Bai Yue feels relieved.
The person who came to open the door was an old man with gray hair, round-rimmed glasses, and a black robe and mandarin jacket. He saw through the wooden door in front of the door that the young master and Mr. Fu, the third generation of his family, were outside the house. He hurriedly pushed past the door and respectfully welcomed the young master and others in.
"Master Zizhen, Master Fu, the eldest lady and the eldest young lady are drinking tea in the main hall. Let's go in now. Who is this young lady?" the old man asked, looking at Bai Yue sandwiched between them.
"This is Mr. Fu's friend Bai Yue. This time I mainly came to visit the old lady and wish her a happy birthday."
Long Zi responded hurriedly and vaguely, fearing that the old man would become suspicious and kick them out before they even entered.
"It turns out to be Miss Bai, please come this way."
The old man naturally regarded Bai Yue, who was traveling with Young Master Fu and others, as the eldest lady of some family. After all, anyone who could establish a relationship with Young Master Fu was definitely not an ordinary person.
When they walked to the main hall, Long Zizhen walked up to Bai Yue, leaned over and reminded: "Sister Bai Yue, when you go in, don't make a big mistake like Mr. Fu did when he first came to the mansion."
After saying that, he turned his eyes to Fu Xinlian and glanced at her.
"Oh? What a big mistake?"
Bai Yue also became interested after hearing this. It would be very interesting to make this gentle and elegant young master Fu embarrassed.
"The eldest lady that Mr. Chen mentioned just now is not any young and beautiful young lady from the second or third generation of our family. There is only one eldest lady in our family, that is, our old lady. The reason why Mr. Chen calls her the eldest lady is because Mr. Chen is the old housekeeper of our family. The master he originally served was my grandfather, and the old lady is my grandfather's sister, and she has never married, so she is still called the eldest lady."
"Logically speaking, she should be considered my aunt, but we usually call her "Old Lady" behind our backs. The last time Mr. Fu came to the mansion, he thought there was an eldest lady in our family, and it made a joke."
"The eldest son Mr. Chen is talking about is my uncle. I, the second generation of the Long family, only have two sons., one is my uncle, and the other is my father. My grandfather and grandmother passed away a few years ago, so I still have to ask the old lady about some important matters. So in this family, it's okay to talk to other people, but I still have to be careful what I say to my uncle and the old lady. "
"By the way, my old lady is an authentic Cantonese. She doesn't speak Mandarin. She can only understand Cantonese and English. I will translate for you when the time comes. "
"I see. "After hearing this, Bai Yue also had a second thought in her heart.
After entering the main hall, Bai Yue saw that most of the house was made of blue bricks and decorated with many colorful Manchurian windows. The main hall was surrounded by precious landscape calligraphy and paintings, and the seats were all made of rosewood, with various reliefs of flowers, birds, fish and insects carved on them.
I saw a graceful and luxurious woman sitting in the center of the lobby, wearing a dark red cheongsam with piping, red lips and curly hair, exquisite makeup, sitting on a chair with a graceful posture. At first glance, she looked like a young lady raised by a wealthy family. However, the emptiness in her eyes revealed the fact that she was now blind.
Is this the old lady of the Long family? She looks like she is only forty years old, but the reality is that her birthday, a week later, will already be in her sixtieth year. She is such a luxurious, elegant and well-maintained young lady from Xiguan!
There were two middle-aged men sitting on both sides of the lobby. The man on the left, Bai Yue, had met once before. He was the first man to buy a Longquan kiln celadon-glazed kiln at the auction that day for 10 million!
Bai Yue later got to know this person. All the famous real estate companies in Eastern Province were owned by him, and his boss was Long Jingming! It turns out that he is Ryuko’s real uncle! And sitting directly in front of him was Long Zi's real father, Long Jingping!
At this time, Manager Chen had already stepped forward to inform the invisible old lady: "Miss, Master Zizhen is back. "
"Yeah? Is Zi really back? Come, come over and let me see. "
The woman sitting on the seat showed a slightly happy expression, and kept groping forward with her hands, and what she said about looking was naturally touching.
Long Zizhen stepped forward, took the old lady's groping hands, put them on his face, and said softly: "Auntie, I am Zizhen, I came back from abroad to see you. "
“Okay, okay, okay. When you go out, you still have to take good care of yourself. Abroad is not as good as at home. I think I also suffered a lot when I was studying abroad. "The old lady stroked Zizhen's face and warned gently.
"Okay, aunt, I understand. " Long Zi replied obediently, then squatted in front of the old lady and said sweetly: "Auntie, your eyes are not good, I brought a doctor back to check your eyes. "
Hearing Long Zi's true words, the old lady immediately lowered her face and said gloomily: "I don't want to take those capsule pills, and I don't want to have surgery. Those compounds have too many side effects and are very harmful to the body. If what you brought back is Western medicine, then let them go. "
When Long Jingming heard Long Zizhen's words, he asked eagerly: "Zizhen, where is the doctor you said you brought? Where? "
Long Zizhen timidly pointed to Bai Yue next to Fu Xinlian and said, "That's the doctor Bai. "
Long Jingming and others looked in the direction of Long Zizhen, and the first thing they saw was Fu Xinlian. She smiled and nodded to him, and then saw the girl following Fu Xinlian.
"Is it her? What diseases can she cure? What a nonsense! "
Long Jingming and others looked at the young Bai Yue and felt that Long Zi was really ridiculous! He actually found a little girl and said he was some kind of miracle doctor. Could it be that he had been deceived by some charlatan?
Long Jingping, who was on the side, also pulled Long Zizhen aside, staring at him with an expression of hatred and said: "Even if you want to find a doctor, you have to find a decent one! "
Long Zizhen, who was scolded by his father's uncle, looked at Fu Xinlian with aggrieved face for help, but Fu Xinlian at this timeAs if he didn't see it, he wanted to see how Bai Yue would react if he didn't help.
